question: How many customers do we have?
List the five most expensive products.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is our total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Which product categories generated the most revenue last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AND o.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Who are our top ten customers by lifetime spend?
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS lifetime_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: What is the month-over-month growth in orders this year?
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, order_count, ROUND(100.0 * (order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month

question: Which products were ordered together most often?
gold_sql: SELECT a.product_id AS product_a, b.product_id AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS times_together FROM order_items a JOIN order_items b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id ORDER BY times_together DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value by region?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: Show me products that are out of stock but were ordered in the last 30 days.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE p.stock_quantity = 0 AND o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
